description: This file defines React components for building user interface filters in a job exploration app, including filter controls like dropdowns, multi-selects, sliders, and filter tags.

methods.name: FieldLabel
methods.description: A simple label component used within filters to display field labels.

methods.name: FieldShell
methods.description: A container component for grouping form fields with consistent spacing.

methods.name: LoadingField
methods.description: Displays a loading skeleton placeholder for a filter field.

methods.name: InlineError
methods.description: Displays an inline error message related to loading or other errors.

methods.name: StructuredSelect
methods.description: A dropdown select component with options fetched from backend or prop.

methods.name: MultiSelectSkills
methods.description: A multi-select component for selecting multiple skills with search and tags.
